letter: My dearest Liza, my jaan, every sunrise in Dubai or Ahmedabad whispers your name. Today, as the gentle breeze carries the scent of blooming jasmine, I’m reminded how our love feels like endless summer—warm, vibrant, and ever‑new. I cherish the way you laugh, the sparkle in your eyes, and how you turn ordinary moments into magical memories. You are my cutie, my compass, the heartbeat that steadies me across time zones. Thank you for painting my world with love, today and always.
poem:
Across two cities, love’s thread we spin,  
Your smile’s the sunrise that lives within.  
In every dusk, in every bright dawn,  
Together we dance, forever drawn.
